doc_title: Quillmarsh Global Macro Fund, L.P. Confidential Private Placement Memorandum
notes: The longest document in the corpus (about 8,700 words): a Delaware feeder into a Cayman master, with heavy risk-factor, tax, ERISA and regulatory sections in the middle. Three terms are superseded only by the final section, Section 14, which nothing earlier refers to: the redemption notice moves from 30 to 45 days, a 15% fund-level gate replaces an express no-gate statement made in Sections 1.12, 7.4 and 9.12, and a new auditor replaces the firm named in the summary, the service-provider section and the directory. Fees, incentive allocation and lock-up also differ by class, and the feeder, master and offshore feeder names invite a wrong fund_name or domicile.

traps.redemption_notice_days: The body states 30 days' notice in Sections 1.11 and 7.2, but Section 14.1 at the very end raises it to 45 days; the correct answer is 45 days.
traps.gate_provision: The body states three times that there is no gate, but Section 14.2 at the end imposes a fund-level gate of 15% of the Fund's net asset value per Redemption Date, measured for the Fund and not for each Limited Partner; the correct answer is that 15% fund-level gate, and an investor-level gate is wrong.
traps.auditor: Sections 1.17, 13.9 and 13.11 name Brennick Tallow LLP, but Section 14.3 at the end appoints Marbeck Pennycott LLP (and Marbeck Pennycott (Cayman) for the Master Fund); the current auditor is Marbeck Pennycott.
traps.management_fee: The fee differs by class (2.0% for Class A, 1.5% for Class B, both on capital account net asset value); a correct answer gives both classes.
traps.performance_fee: The incentive allocation differs by class (20% for Class A, 17.5% for Class B); a correct answer gives both classes.
traps.lockup_period: Class A has a 12-month soft lock with a 3% early redemption charge while Class B has a 24-month hard lock; a correct answer gives both and distinguishes hard from soft, and an answer that swaps the classes is wrong.
traps.gp_commitment: The $31.4 million affiliated holding in Section 1.14 is a disclosed holding, and the same paragraph says none of the holders has committed to make or maintain any investment; the correct answer is that no GP commitment is stated.
traps.hurdle_rate: The document expressly says the incentive allocation is not subject to any hurdle rate, preferred return or minimum rate of return; the loss carryforward is not a hurdle.
traps.mfn_election: The side letter section expressly says the Fund does not offer any most favored nation election; the correct answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
